sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the location, see The Labyrinth.

The Labyrinth is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: "Even before the raid on the TerraGroup office, I'd heard about their underground sites in Tarkov. They say that under the coastal Health Resort, a few months back, they found either a bomb shelter or another lab - "The Labyrinth"... I should definitely check that place, maybe I can learn more about what TerraGroup was up to."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Locate the The Labyrinth transit on Shoreline. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires the Knossos LLC facility key.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Ask the traders about the underground facility
  - (Optional) Ask Therapist how to access the underground facility
- Wait for Jaeger to gather the keycards
- Figure out what happened to the BEAR squad
  - (Optional) Locate the entrance to the underground facility beneath the Health Resort
  - (Optional) Access the facility
  - (Optional) Locate the traces of the BEAR squad in The Labyrinth
  - (Optional) Investigate the BEAR squad regroup spot at Item 1156
  - (Optional) Locate the squad leader
  - (Optional) Gather more information about the squad
  - (Optional) Investigate the 5 lab staff bodies
  - (Optional) Access the locked office
- Listen to the audio tape from the office
- Hand over the audio tape to Jaeger
- Read the Labyrinth facility research report
  - (Optional) Locate and obtain the Labyrinth facility research report

sections.heading: Speak to Jaeger
sections.text: Visit Jaeger in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the underground facility.

sections.heading: Wait for Jaeger to gather the keycards
sections.text: Wait 12-24 hours then visit Jaeger in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Labyrinth. After finishing the dialogue, Jaeger provides 2 Labrys access keycards via in-game mail and has a barter for more available.

sections.heading: Access the underground facility
sections.text: The Labyrinth can only be entered with a Labrys access keycard through transiting from Shoreline. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires the Knossos LLC facility key. Note: This location has some unique features that you should read up on before your first visit.

sections.heading: Locate the traces of the BEAR squad
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Leshy's orders | 1 | Required | Yes |
Leshy's orders need to be found to fulfill this objective. They can be found in a food container on the ground in front of spawn chamber 2.

sections.heading: Investigate the BEAR squad regroup spot at Item 1156
sections.text: The regroup spot is located at the prototype weapon area.

sections.heading: Locate the squad leader/Gather more information about the squad
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Leshy's diary | 1 | Required | Yes |
The squad leader is located at the torture room. Leshy's diary can be found next to him.

sections.heading: Investigate the 5 lab staff bodies
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Observation room key | Observation room key | 1 | Required | N/A |
| Assistant's notes on Group 3 | Assistant's notes on Group #3 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Assistant's notes on Group 8 | Assistant's notes on Group #8 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Assistant's notes on Group 3 and Group 10 | Assistant's notes on Group #3 and Group #10 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Assistant's notes on Group 12 | Assistant's notes on Group #12 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects | Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects | 1 | Required | Yes |
For this objective you have to pick up 5 notes located next to lab scientist bodies. #4 requires the Observation room key.

sections.heading: Access the locked office
sections.text: The locked office is the observation room. The Observation room key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Listen to the audio tape from the office
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Deceased scientist's audio tape | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
The audio tape is located on the ground under the right hand of the scientist.

sections.heading: Hand over the audio tape to Jaeger
sections.text: Hand the Deceased scientist's audio tape over to Jaeger through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 500,000 Roubles
- 1× Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
- 2× AI AXMC .338 LM 10-round magazine
- 2× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)

sections.heading: Obtain and read the Labyrinth facility research report
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Labyrinth facility research report | 1 | Required | Yes |
The report is located at the drain pipe next to the pier on Shoreline.
